title: Preallocate INDEX schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when CREATE INDEX and DROP INDEX build schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added index_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced CREATE INDEX schema lookup key construction.
Replaced DROP INDEX single-column schema update key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: INDEX schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving index creation, index backfill, DROP INDEX schema updates, and index-cache behavior.
